alternatives.option: Relax the ancestor-membership rule for same-batch delivery
alternatives.reason_rejected: lane 02b chose replica-state deliberately so an event judged earlier in a batch than the membership cannot slip through on the bootstrap exemption; that is the ADR's rule, not an accident

context: Merged lane/04-retrieval into foundation/v3 (no conflicts) and fixed a production defect it exposed: no adapter write path cited the membership policy, so every mirrored write on a store with a policy would have been quarantined.
rationale: 65 tests across 8 case files failed because they delivered a policy alongside the events it grants without linking them. The slice harness's own C10 fixture already threads infra ids as parents, so the shape was established; lane 04 was written before the ancestor rule landed. citeParents re-stamps an already-built envelope with extra parents, recomputing the digest and re-signing with whichever fixture key signed it — safe because created() fixes the record id up front and parents feed only digest and signature, so every id a test already captured survives.
summary: Fixed the lane-04 acceptance fixtures to link the policy rather than relaxing the admission rule, adding citeParents()/deliverUnderPolicy() to the slice harness
